landmarks.name: canopy bed

landmarks.name: window with dark trim
landmarks.description: Multi-pane window set in a yellow upper wall with dark gray-blue wood paneling below

landmarks.name: dark radiator
landmarks.description: Dark cast-iron radiator mounted against the dark lower wall paneling under the window

landmarks.name: brown wooden paneled wall
landmarks.description: Unpainted distressed brown wood-paneled wall with a small fireplace opening in the center

landmarks.name: gothic wooden chair
landmarks.description: Dark carved wooden chair with a light cushion standing against the brown wood-paneled wall

landmarks.name: stacked black cases
landmarks.description: Pile of flat black rectangular cases or trunks on the floor in the corner near the doorway

landmarks.name: open wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Dark wooden doorway with an open paneled door leading to a passage

landmarks.name: dark chest on cabinet

landmarks.name: taxidermy animal heads

landmarks.name: tall white bookshelves

landmarks.name: blue and white robed statue

landmarks.name: large wooden framed mirror

landmarks.name: portrait over fireplace

landmarks.name: floral armchair

landmarks.name: clawfoot bathtub
landmarks.description: Freestanding white clawfoot bathtub in the middle of the floor on patterned rugs

landmarks.name: white wall sink
landmarks.description: Wide white porcelain wall-mounted sink surrounded by small framed pictures on a yellow wall

landmarks.name: wicker trunk

landmarks.name: wall of crosses

landmarks.name: window with stained glass hanging

landmarks.name: dark Madonna and Child statue

landmarks.name: skylight

landmarks.name: stone statue by shelves

landmarks.name: yellow slotted wooden box
landmarks.description: Long yellow-painted wooden trough or box with vertical slots along its side, mounted at chest height

landmarks.name: framed pictures on passage wall

landmarks.name: large pink and blue patterned rug

landmarks.name: cluttered wooden desk

landmarks.name: two windows with portrait between

landmarks.name: dark bust on desk
landmarks.description: Dark bronze or wood sculpted bust sitting on top of the cluttered wooden desk

landmarks.name: tall glass-front wooden bookcase

landmarks.name: wooden ladder

landmarks.name: floral bedspread bed

connections.how: With the window with dark trim and dark radiator on your left and the canopy bed on your right, walk straight ahead to the brown wooden paneled wall.
Turn right in place past the gothic wooden chair and stacked black cases on your left to face the open wooden doorway with the canopy bed and dark chest on cabinet on your right.
Walk forward through the open wooden doorway between the stacked black cases and dark chest on cabinet toward the stairs with taxidermy animal heads ahead on the left.
With the doorway to the tall white bookshelves on your right, turn left and walk along the short passage to the blue and white robed statue on your left.
Pass the blue and white robed statue on your left and step through the doorway toward the large wooden framed mirror on the left and the portrait over fireplace and floral armchair ahead.

Turn past the blue and white robed statue, then turn right and walk between the floral armchair on the left and the clawfoot bathtub and white wall sink on the right to reach the wicker trunk, wall of crosses, and window with stained glass hanging.

Turn around past the white toilet with high tank on the left, then walk between the white wall sink on the left and the clawfoot bathtub on the right back to the doorway by the blue and white robed statue.
Step out through the doorway leaving the blue and white robed statue behind on the right, and face down the narrow passage under the skylight with the dark Madonna and Child statue on the left.
Walk forward under the skylight and look left into the open wooden doorway where the gothic wooden chair is visible.
With the open wooden doorway on your left, turn right to face down the narrow passage toward the stone statue by shelves on the left and the yellow slotted wooden box on the right.
Turn 180 degrees past the framed pictures on passage wall and walk back along the narrow passage with the yellow slotted wooden box on your left toward the taxidermy animal heads.
Before reaching the stairs with the taxidermy animal heads, turn left through the open doorway into the area lined with tall white bookshelves and a large pink and blue patterned rug.

Cross the large pink and blue patterned rug with the tall white bookshelves on your right and the cluttered wooden desk with the dark bust on desk on your left toward the wooden easel and two windows with portrait between.
Turn left past the cluttered wooden desk and dark bust on desk to face the fireplace with dark overmantel and the tall glass-front wooden bookcase.
Turn right and walk forward across the large pink and blue patterned rug with the fireplace with dark overmantel on your left toward the two windows with portrait between and wooden easel.

Turn around to the left past the fireplace with dark overmantel and tall glass-front wooden bookcase, then walk across the large pink and blue patterned rug with the cluttered wooden desk on your right and tall white bookshelves on your left toward the door with oval plaque.
Exit through the open doorway beside the door with oval plaque, passing the wooden ladder on the left, onto the stair landing below the taxidermy animal heads.

connections.to: large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns
connections.how: Walk straight across the landing from the wooden ladder through the opposite doorway, passing the large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns on the right and floral bedspread bed on the left toward the small fireplace with armour portrait and dark wooden trunk.

connections.from: large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns
connections.how: Turn 180 degrees and walk out through the doorway between the large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns on your left and floral bedspread bed on your right toward the wooden ladder on the landing.

With the wooden ladder on your left, turn around and re-enter through the doorway between the floral bedspread bed on the left and large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns on the right, walking past the bed and small fireplace with armour portrait to the frosted window with cross in the far left corner.

walk_summary: Start between the window with dark trim and dark radiator on the left and the canopy bed on the right, and walk forward to the brown wooden paneled wall.
Turn right past the gothic wooden chair and stacked black cases to face the open wooden doorway beside the canopy bed and dark chest on cabinet.
Walk through the open wooden doorway toward the stair landing with taxidermy animal heads on the left and a doorway to tall white bookshelves on the right.
Turn left and walk past the blue and white robed statue into the area with the large wooden framed mirror, portrait over fireplace, and floral armchair.

Turn around the blue and white robed statue and walk between the floral armchair on the left and the clawfoot bathtub and white wall sink on the right up to the wicker trunk, wall of crosses, and window with stained glass hanging.
Turn around past the white toilet with high tank and walk between the white wall sink and clawfoot bathtub back out the doorway past the blue and white robed statue.
Walk down the narrow passage under the skylight past the dark Madonna and Child statue on the left and look left into the open wooden doorway at the gothic wooden chair.

Face further down the passage toward the stone statue by shelves and yellow slotted wooden box, then turn 180 degrees past the framed pictures on passage wall and walk back toward the taxidermy animal heads.
Turn left through the open doorway into the area with tall white bookshelves, a large pink and blue patterned rug, a cluttered wooden desk, and a door with oval plaque.
Walk alongside the cluttered wooden desk and dark bust on desk toward the wooden easel and two windows with portrait between.
Turn left to view the fireplace with dark overmantel and tall glass-front wooden bookcase, then walk back toward the two windows with portrait between.
Turn around and walk past the tall glass-front wooden bookcase, cluttered wooden desk, and tall white bookshelves to the doorway beside the door with oval plaque.

Exit past the wooden ladder onto the landing with taxidermy animal heads and walk straight through the opposite doorway between the floral bedspread bed and large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns toward the small fireplace with armour portrait and dark wooden trunk.
Turn around and step back out to the landing facing the wooden ladder, then turn around again to re-enter between the floral bedspread bed and large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns.

Walk past the floral bedspread bed to the far corner under the frosted window with cross, then turn around to face the dark wooden trunk, floral bedspread bed, and large wooden wardrobe with barley-twist columns.

source.camera: held at chest height by a person walking
